page.layout: One column of text. Running head at top left, page number at top right, with a subhead "Aliud Exemplum." beneath it. Several arithmetic displays set within the text. Signature at foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Aliud Exemplum.
main_text.p: Quispiam natus est Anno Christi 1562. Nunc autem annus est Christi 1588. Quæritur quot annos natus sit?
Scribo primùm numerum majorem: deinde directè minorem subnoto:
Et dico 1 ab 1 remanet nihil: 5 à 5 remanet nihil: 6 ab 8 remanent 2, quæ supra noto: 2 ab 8 remanent 6, quæ supra scribo.
Si autem scire cupio an rectè subduxerim: addo inferiorem numerum superiori: Et si tum medius numerus redierit, rectè subductum est: ut,

page.notes: The "Aliud Exemplum." line is italic beneath the running head; it is given as a level 2 heading. The asterisks in "7* 4 5* 4" are small printed marks, possibly bracket or multiplication signs; the bracket to the right of the first display is not transcribed. A rule separates the sum from the display above it. Printed "1562" and "1588" are set with spaced figures in the display; they are copied as the numbers they show.
